title: Using the site — Open Circuit SF
description: Find Open Circuit SF events and workshops, register for them, read the guides, and browse the newsletter archive.

intro.text: Open Circuit SF runs hands-on electronics workshops in San Francisco. This site lists the events, holds the guides, and keeps an archive of past newsletters.

blocks.text: The Events page lists upcoming workshops and other events, followed by past events. You can filter the list by event type.

Registration does not happen on this site. When an event has a sign-up page, its event page shows a "Register for this event" link that opens that page. Upcoming sessions are also listed on the Luma calendar, linked as "Calendar" in the footer of every page.
Short, hands-on electronics explainers: one idea each, with something to press, drag or break.
Past newsletter emails are published in the archive.
